model.title: Crow Revenue Act
model.meta: Indian Affairs Committee · Sen. Steve Daines (R-MT)

summary.text: The bill would transfer certain federal and private mineral and surface land interests in Montana between the United States, the Crow Tribe, the Hope Family Trust, and Musselshell Resources LLC, mainly to consolidate ownership and unlock public access. It would require the Bull Mountains Lease to be relinquished if the lessee offers, and would have the Tribe's mineral interests held in trust by the United States for the Tribe on request, exempt from state taxation. The Tribe and the Hope Family Trust would need to agree on a revenue-sharing formula for future development of certain mineral interests returned to the Hope Family Trust. Pending these exchanges, the affected tracts would be withdrawn from entry, mining claims, and mineral leasing. The bill would also state that benefits given to the Tribe under it could not reduce federal services or programs the Tribe or its members are entitled to.
